script: Hitler once ordered his own soldiers to kidnap the Pope. In 1943, after Italy surrendered, German forces occupied Rome, and Hitler grew furious that the Vatican was sheltering refugees and resisting Nazi demands. He ordered an SS general to plan the kidnapping of Pope Pius the Twelfth and ship him to Germany. But here's the part nobody mentions, the general assigned to the mission quietly slow-walked every step, stalling reports and losing paperwork on purpose. Hitler's own commanders feared the backlash of arresting the Pope during a war they were already losing. The order was never carried out, and Hitler never found out how close his own general came to simply refusing him outright.
